title: The Satyricon of Petronius Arbiter

authorInfo.bio: Petronius Arbiter (20–66) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "The Satyricon of Petronius Arbiter" by Petronius Arbiter is a Latin work of fiction written in the late 1st century AD. This fragmentary Roman novel follows narrator Encolpius and his companion Giton through a series of bizarre, erotic, and comic adventures in the Roman underworld.
